boundaryRule: Only visitor places physically inside Kemback's strict study area, or an explicitly related cross-boundary route that genuinely serves it, are published.
scoreRationale: Kemback has attractive Dura Den woodland and two verified self-guided routes, including the live Treasure Trail, but no current café or public toilet and no reliably open staffed attraction. The nature asset appears under See while the place remains off the town map.
